plain_text:
Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Edmond O’Brien is credited on 79 distinct recordings across 6 programs from 1939-05-08 through 1952-07-02. Documented roles include performer on 79 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar (performer on 72 recordings; 72 distinct recordings), Lux Radio Theatre (performer on 2 recordings; 2 distinct recordings), Screen Directors Playhouse (performer on 2 recordings; 2 distinct recordings), Escape (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), Fu Manchu (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), and NBC University Theater (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording).

Documented character portrayals include Johnny Dollar (77 portrayals) and Inspector Rymer (1 portrayals).
